renderer.font: DejaVu Sans (text drawn as glyph outlines in SVG)
renderer.png: opaque 8-bit sRGB, embedded sRGB ICC profile, 300 dpi stored as 11811 px/m

hero.projection: orthographic, geographic north up, fixed cameras

encode.ffmpeg: ffmpeg version 7.0.2-static https://johnvansickle.com/ffmpeg/  Copyright (c) 2000-2024 the FFmpeg developers

relaxation-fields.contours: actual relax_weight interpolated on the triangulation; W = exp(-1) solid (cones) / dashed (controls); W = 0.001 dotted

encode.ffmpeg: ffmpeg version 7.0.2-static https://johnvansickle.com/ffmpeg/  Copyright (c) 2000-2024 the FFmpeg developers

gif.note: Lossy GIF compression changes pixel values slightly; the MP4 is the source.

error_colour_scale.quantity: E_pair = sqrt((w_i e_i^2 + w_p e_p^2)/(w_i + w_p)) per unique point

interpolation.error: piecewise linear on convex-hull facets of the unique points (radial projection), 2x2 supersampled per output pixel, analytic limb coverage
interpolation.vorticity: bilinear in latitude and longitude on the native Gaussian grid, periodic longitude; poleward of the outermost Gaussian latitude a linear blend in polar distance to the ring-mean pole value

time.timing: 576 frames at 24 fps: frames 0-23 hold day 0; frames 24-527 map day 0 to day 14 linearly (inclusive); frames 528-575 hold day 14; each frame shows the most recent saved snapshot, cursor at that snapshot's stored time
